title: Name ratified: ZONOID (T0 for the OSS release clock)
summary: User ratified ZONOID as the public name (2026-06-10), ending three naming rounds. Rationale: Oloid-aesthetic phonetic twin, cleanest collision profile found (npm/PyPI/crates free, no company, no in-space project, zonoid.dev/.ai/.io unregistered); tagline "Every segment adds to the solid" (zonoid = limit of summed line segments). Rejected with receipts: Darwin (Sakana DGM + getdarwin.ai), Oloid (OLOID Inc $23M), Varve (user vibe), Verdict (Haize Labs' PyPI judge framework — direct in-space collision; salvage: keep lowercase "verdict" as in-product vocabulary for judge outputs). Per release-plan-2026-06.md, T0 starts the W0-W9 clock: same-day handle reservation (npm/PyPI/crates + GitHub org zonoid-dev + domains) is the critical-path next step, then fresh-repo cut W0-1, Show HN ~mid-July. GitHub note: username "zonoid" is an active individual — use org zonoid-dev.
